_about: Findings tools/seo/audit.js keeps reporting but should not fail a run, because the user has ruled on them (each with the ruling it rests on). They still print, as notes marked «accepted». Match on code and `where` (the path the audit prints); `until` (YYYY-MM-DD) makes an acceptance expire. Add an entry only for a real ruling, never to silence a finding nobody has looked at.
